quick_skim.title: DTFormer: Text-Guided Semantic Alignment for RGB-D Segmentation
quick_skim.abstract: RGB-D semantic segmentation has made notable progress by fusing RGB and Depth, yet mainstream models still learn features almost exclusively from pixel-level supervision, lacking direct high-level semantic constraints. This raises a central question-can external knowledge such as language priors inject stronger semantic discriminability into mainstream RGB-D segmentation models. We present DTFormer, a novel tri-modal (RGB-D-Text) semantic segmentation framework. At its core is Text-guided Semantic Alignment Module (TSAM) that first encodes textual cues into a set of semantic prototypes and then explicitly aligns multi-modal RGB-D features with these prototypes at multiple encoder and decoder layers. This design imposes strong semantic regularization on representation learning, guiding the network toward more discriminative features. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that DTFormer delivers consistent gains while remaining simple and efficient. Our results demonstrate that explicit semantic alignment offers an effective and practical route to improving RGB-D semantic segmentation. The code will be released upon acceptance.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: RGB-D semantic segmentation lacks high-level semantic constraints. DTFormer adds a text-guided semantic alignment module aligning RGB-D features with text prototypes, injecting language priors into segmentation.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 主流RGB-D语义分割模型主要依赖像素级监督，缺乏高层语义约束，限制了判别能力。本文提出三模态RGB-D-文本分割框架DTFormer，其核心文本引导语义对齐模块将文本编码为语义原型，并在编码器与解码器多层显式对齐多模态特征。该设计以语言先验对表示施加语义正则，提升了分割性能。

quick_skim.title: Do Image Editors Follow Depth-Dependent Blur and Aperture Response? A Rendered-Ground-Truth Pilot Audit
quick_skim.abstract: General image editors are asked to make a photo look as if it were taken at f/1.4, yet it is rarely checked whether the blur they add follows thin-lens optics. A physical aperture edit spreads blur across depth in thin-lens proportions and changes the blur when the aperture changes; prior evaluations check blur monotonicity, sharpness-trend correlation, effective-aperture error, or vision-language judgments, and none we found reports the two properties separately at known depths. In this pilot audit of two editors (Gemini~3.1 Flash Image and GPT-image-2.5) we compare against a rendered oracle: Blender Cycles scenes with true thin-lens depth of field, one blur-width estimator applied identically to oracle and editor outputs, and preregistered depth and aperture indices. In 24 texture scenes rendered in one three-panel geometry, accepted and measurable panels show f/1.4-to-f/2.8 width ratios, $\barσ_{1.4}/\barσ_{2.8}$, of 0.99--1.18 against 1.98--2.13 for the oracle, and ratios of pooled median Gaussian-equivalent near/far blur widths of about 1.18--1.25 (Gemini) and 0.97--1.05 (GPT-image) against 1.69--1.82. Preregistered black-box interventions show that qualitative wording changes blur strength by roughly 2--10 times, whereas a request for 2 versus 6 px changes it 1.1--1.3 times and no tested wording of the f-number meets the registered ``followed'' criterion. The depth compression appears in the original and reversed centre-focus layouts; with the focus on the near panel, the available-panel depth index reaches the registered threshold, and the aperture response stays attenuated in every layout tested. Scalar metrics adapted from published ones give oracle-like scores to synthetic editors whose proportions are compressed.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: audits depth-dependent blur and aperture response against thin-lens depth of field

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: The paper audits whether general image editors add blur that follows thin-lens optics, separating blur spread across depth from aperture response using a Blender Cycles rendered oracle. It provides a physically grounded evaluation of depth-dependent defocus blur, useful for validating learned bokeh and depth-of-field rendering.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该文关注通用图像编辑器在模拟大光圈虚化时，其模糊是否真正符合薄透镜光学规律。作者用Blender Cycles渲染出具有真实薄透镜景深的图像作为参照，将沿深度扩散的模糊与随光圈变化的响应分别度量，对两个编辑器进行审计。结果显示此前评测未分别报告这两项特性，而该框架为学习式景深与散景渲染提供了物理可信的评测依据，有助于虚化算法验证。

quick_skim.title: Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning
quick_skim.abstract: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the lossy VAE of latent models, which suggests an advantage on downstream tasks where fine-grained detail matters. We test this claim along both routes to a pixel-space backbone. We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a $256\to512\to1024$ curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at $256^2$ to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space. We fine-tune both families for monocular depth estimation and for image restoration/super-resolution. We find no significant improvement from using a pixel-space generative prior. Fine-tuned for depth with one matched direct-regression recipe, Iris-3B is level with the latent FLUX.2 Klein and the converted pixel FLUX.2 Klein falls behind it, and on $4\times$ DIV2K restoration neither pixel model beats a latent FLUX.2 Klein fine-tune, the converted one trailing it slightly. We document the recipes, the failure modes and the remaining confounds behind this negative result. Nevertheless, Iris-3B shows that pixel-space pretraining with the pixel-transformer (PiT) head of PixelDiT scales to 3B parameters and to text-to-image quality competitive with latent models, matching Qwen-Image on OneIG under the official evaluators at $1024^2$. We release its weights and training code in the hope that they help pave the way for further work on pixel-space generation.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Iris-3B tests whether pixel-space diffusion beats latent models on fine-detail tasks; it pretrains a 3B pixel-space text-to-image transformer and fine-tunes it for monocular depth estimation and restoration, finding no significant benefit from pixel-space priors.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该工作探讨像素空间扩散模型能否因避免有损VAE而在细节敏感的下游任务上占优。作者从零预训练3B参数像素空间文本到图像Transformer，并将预训练潜空间模型转换到像素空间，随后针对单目深度估计与图像修复/超分进行微调。结果显示像素空间生成先验并未带来显著提升，为像素空间与潜空间扩散路线的选择提供了实证参考。
